sanskrit_verse: क्षेत्रं त्रिपुरुषं यत् स्याद् गृहं वा स्यात् क्रमागतम् । राजप्रसादाद् अन्यत्र न तद्भोगः परं नयेत् ॥
transliteration: kṣetraṃ tripuruṣaṃ yat syād gṛhaṃ vā syāt kramāgatam | rājaprasādād anyatra na tadbhogaḥ paraṃ nayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That field or house which has been rightfully acquired through three generations of lawful possession, or obtained in proper order, shall not be enjoyed by another without the explicit authorization of the ruling sovereign.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in the ruling sovereign to determine rightful enjoyment of property
Causation is established through lawful generational continuity and procedural correctness
Capacity-based responsibility requires acknowledgment of sovereign sanction for trans-generational entitlements
Restoration logic ensures alignment between ownership, consciousness, and social harmony
Consciousness alignment mandates recognition of legitimate acquisition as a reflection of dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF property ownership spans three successive generations AND was acquired lawfully THEN unauthorized use by another party is invalid WITHOUT explicit sovereign consent
IF a claimant lacks documented royal approval for usage of ancestral property THEN system SHALL reject claim automatically
IF transfer of property occurs outside prescribed lineage OR prescribed method THEN legal engine MUST flag misalignment with dharma-based jurisprudence
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes over ancestral or traditionally-held properties, the Supreme Court must recognize that mere factual possession does not equate to lawful entitlement unless validated by sovereign grace. The threshold of responsibility lies in verifying the legitimacy of generational inheritance under royal dispensation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse establishes pramāṇa-based causality where lawful enjoyment depends upon sequential manifestation of title through sanctioned means. There is no punitive intent; rather, it realigns societal understanding to uphold dharma through conscious recognition of rightful order without inflicting harm.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate return of disputed asset to recognized holder through verified documentation trail
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require disputing party to formally acknowledge prior lawful possession before engaging further
Capacity Restoration: Provide access to records and royal archives to validate claims transparently
Integrity Reintegration: Establish public registry linking generational holdings with sovereign confirmation
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Ownership rooted in lawful succession aligns with Dharma. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
